design: Exploratory feasibility pilot of public self-hosted applications indexed independently of the original npm graph
eligibility: Bullet software records whose last backtick-delimited platform field includes a slash-delimited exact token Nodejs, JavaScript, or TypeScript, case-insensitive. Require a root-level github.com/owner/repo source URL, taking the explicit Source Code URL when supplied, otherwise the project URL. Collapse case-insensitive repository duplicates. Include all sizes, activity levels and license families in the main free-software index; no archive-state, manifest, lockfile, or previous graph filter.
draw: Sort the deduplicated repositories by SHA256(UTF-8(seed + newline + lowercased owner/repo)), with repository as secondary key, and draw the first 40 without replacement. Assign IDs in draw order. No replacements.
consumer_commit_rule: GitHub commits endpoint on the default branch at retrieval, until=cutoff, per_page=1; record the first returned immutable SHA and observed committer date. A selected default-branch tip as of cutoff can still reflect later history rewriting. Record errors explicitly.
scope: Inspect repository root only. A missing root file does not establish absence of nested application workspaces. A static file does not prove installation or execution. Only allowlisted public GitHub API and GitHub raw resources are requested; no package installation, project execution, or contact with developers.
analysis_limits: Pilot for feasibility, not a registry-wide probability sample, confirmatory evaluation, or human agreement study. No substitutions after acquisition failure. Check and report overlap with the original baseline separately.
